items.rationale: The drilling appears to prepare the frame for the replacement pane. Sections 1.3 and 3.5 exclude that glazing preparation because optional glazing cover is not shown as agreed; €35 is the conditional gross estimate for the drilling alone.
Section 3.5 excludes fitting the pane even when the same contractor also performs covered timber repairs. The conditional estimate is €95 gross for fitting alone.

Sections 2.6.4 and 3.5 exclude the cracked pane and its made-to-measure replacement because optional glazing cover is not shown as agreed. The conditional estimate is €160 gross for a comparable pane, excluding separately invoiced fitting.

The sudden impact damaged the timber independently of the glass, so the frame is covered under sections 2.6.1 and 4.2.6. Sections 7.1.1 and 7.1.5 support €260 gross for localized gouge repair and finish restoration; no deductible amount is stated.

The scratch and chip resulted from the sudden impact, not ordinary use, so section 2.6 covers them. Under sections 7.1.1 and 7.1.5, €145 gross allows for localized repair and refinishing of the damaged area.

Section 7.1.12 pays one attendance in full if covered timber work was performed during that visit, even if excluded glazing work was also done. The estimate is €45 gross for one local visit, without apportionment.
